title: Server
description: The server the runner is a client of: where it fetches its configuration from, and the access key and secret it signs every request with. Lives outside the checkout, beside the policy. Configuring a server makes the run fail closed: no run starts unless the server answers the discovery fetch and the ping.

version.description: The document format. A runner refuses a version it does not read.

url.description: The server's origin: scheme and host, with a port when there is one, and nothing after it. https, or http to a loopback address only. The runner fetches its configuration from /.well-known/qory-configuration under it.

access_key.description: The key the server knows the runner by, sent in clear on every request: ak_ and 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

secret.description: The key of the HMAC SHA-256 signature on every request. It signs and never travels: shared with the server and with nothing else, it is the credential of this run's reporting.
